answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> The Holy Quran Question ID: 7690 Country: India Title: Most of the time i am in the office. Is it allowed to listen or read quraan on computer/ipod/mobile without wudu. Will we get any reward? Jazaakumullah! Question: Most of the time i am in the office. Is it allowed to listen or read quraan on computer/ipod/mobile without wudu. Will we get any reward? Jazaakumullah! Answer ID: 7690 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1000/1000=M/1429) It is allowed to read or listen to the Quran without wudhu on computer or mobile phone, but when the verses appear on the screen one should not touch it without wudhu . It is a matter of reward if the Quran is recited with due respect without desecration. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
